title: Antenna Dreaming
style: shoegaze, washed-out reverb guitars, dreamy female vocal buried in mix, slow snare, swelling synth pads, 76 bpm, melancholic, hazy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There's an antenna in my chest
It picks up everything you said
On nights when you were half asleep
In rooms I never even let

[Verse 2]
I dream in static, I dream in tone
I dream a kitchen, I dream a phone
I dream the way your laugh would go
Through every wire, every snow

[Chorus]
I'm only antenna dreaming
I'm only antenna dreaming
Receiving you, receiving you
Across the years, across the blue

[Verse 3]
The tower says you still exist
Somewhere far, on a list
The tower says the love we made
Is riding waves that never fade

[Chorus]
I'm only antenna dreaming
I'm only antenna dreaming
Receiving you, receiving you
Across the years, across the blue

[Bridge]
If you can hear me, blink the light
If you can hear me, hum tonight
If you can hear me, send a tone
I'm not asleep, I'm not alone

[Outro]
Receiving, receiving, receiving you
Receiving, receiving, blue
